task: Fix settings loading across settings.py and merge.py. resolve(defaults, file_config, overrides) merges dictionaries recursively with precedence overrides > file_config > defaults. None at an update key means inherit the existing value (do not add an absent key). Explicit False, 0, empty string, empty list are real overrides. Dictionaries merge only when both values are dictionaries; other values including lists replace. The result and all nested containers must be independent of every input. load_settings must use fresh DEFAULTS each call without mutating it. Preserve APIs. Public reproduction: setting worker count to zero is ignored.
